objective: Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Panthers.

description: Now you're ready to turn it up a notch.  If you want to prove yourself worthy of socializing with the likes of these big game hunters, you'll need to prove that you can kill 10 panthers.
Those big boys are tougher.  They're not as easy as the young ones you were killing earlier.
